subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Impediment
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impediment"** means a hindrance or obstruction in doing something. (बाधा)

 
 
• **Example: **His lack of confidence was a serious** impediment** to his career growth.
 
 
 
• **"Obstacle" **refers to something that blocks one's way or prevents progress. (अवरोध)
 
 
• **Example: **The fallen tree was an** obstacle **on the road, causing a traffic jam.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Experiment **(प्रयोग): A scientific procedure undertaken to test a hypothesis.

 
 
• **Example:** The** experiment **was successful in proving the theory.
 
 
 
• **Pedestrian **(पैदल यात्री): A person walking rather than traveling in a vehicle.
 
 
• **Example:** **Pedestrians** should always use the crosswalk for safety.
 
 
 
• **Benefit** (लाभ): An advantage or profit gained from something.
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise has numerous health** benefits.**
